verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix explicitly runs autonomously in the background: it 'automatically scans issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage' and can 'generate a code fix and create a PR' without manual triggering, plus alert rules that fire automatically on new issues. This is well documented first-party but missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Autofix's autonomous reliability and any scheduling/cron-style automation beyond issue-triggered workflows.
